hebrew:
עֹמְדוֹת הָיוּ רַגְלֵינוּ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם.

יְרוּשָׁלַם הַבְּנוּיָה כְּעִיר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּהּ יַחְדָּו.

לְשָׁנָה הַבָּאָה בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם.
translation:
Our feet are standing within thy gates, O Jerusalem;

Jerusalem, that art builded as a city that is compact together.

Psalm 122:2-3, translation from Jewish Publication Society, 1917 (Open source)

Next year in Jerusalem.
